The Intelligent Guardian
The Powerhouse with Active Protection
Designed for uncompromising gamers and creators, the MWE Gold V4 delivers the rock-solid stability required for today’s most demanding PC builds. Fully compliant with ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 standards, this fully modular powerhouse is engineered from the ground up to drive flagship systems.More than just efficient power delivery, the MWE Gold V4 is also built to protect your GPU. Featuring Cooler Master’s patent-pending GPU Shield Intelligent Current Management, it acts as a real-time guardian for your most valuable components, ensuring peace of mind even under extreme workloads.
GPU Shield Intelligent Current Management
Automatically detects abnormal current, and alerts users through LED indicators for safer, more stable power delivery.
Digital Control IC
Engineered with digital control IC to achieve precise digital tuning of PFC and LLC, improving the overall efficiency 3% higher than previous series.
Thermal Excellence
Wave-type heatsink design to optimize internal airflow and heat dissipation path of PSU to better manage the operation temperature.

Conformal Coating

10-year warranty
